meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 处理地理数据时,本地检查并给出操作指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Python 分析带地理坐标的数据,需要确保操作正确。
copy.tagline_en: Run local audits and get guidance on geospatial data handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze geographic data in Python and want to keep your methods correct.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你写和检查用 GeoPandas 处理矢量地理数据的 Python 代码:读写 Shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage 等格式,做空间连接、坐标转换和出图。
howto.when: 当你处理矢量地理数据、做空间分析或读写地理文件时触发,如坐标转换、空间连接、绘制地图等。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 读取 data.geojson,打印坐标系和几何类型
say.note: 会读取文件并输出 CRS 与 geom_type

say.text: 把这个 shapefile 重投影到 EPSG:3857 并计算多边形面积
say.note: 会转换坐标并新增面积列

say.text: 用 gpd.sjoin 按 within 把点数据关联到多边形上
say.note: 会执行空间连接并返回结果表

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write and audit Python code that uses GeoPandas on vector geospatial data: reading/writing Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, spatial joins, CRS reprojection, and drawing maps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with vector geographic data, do spatial analysis, or read/write geospatial files, such as reprojection, spatial joins, or making maps.

say_en.text: Read data.geojson with GeoPandas and print its CRS and geometry types
say_en.note: Reads the file, shows CRS and geom_type

say_en.text: Reproject this shapefile to EPSG:3857 and compute polygon areas
say_en.note: Transforms coordinates, adds an area column

say_en.text: Spatially join points to polygons with gpd.sjoin using within
say_en.note: Runs the join and returns a result table
